# Partha Deshpande

> Senior Data Analyst at Bolt (Tallinn, since Sep 2026) and founder of Advisoira, a SEBI-registered fee-only investment advisory practice in India. Nine years in analytics across five cities and five companies.

## Work
- Bolt, Senior Data Analyst (Sep 2026 to now): incentive experiments, quarterly budget, Delivery-as-a-Service analytics.
- FedEx, Senior Data Analyst 2 (Mar 2025 to Aug 2026): four audit pipelines, run time cut from two hours to 15 minutes, pricing monitor.
- Zepto, Senior Analytics Manager (Aug 2024 to Mar 2025): churn cohort analysis; against a control group retention rose 300 bps and reactivation rose 10 percent.
- Swiggy Instamart, Senior Business Associate (Jun 2023 to Aug 2024): defined Orders per Day and GMV, A/B tests and root-cause analyses.
- ZS, Decision Analytics Associate (May 2021 to Jun 2023): dashboards for 2,000+ sales reps, Oracle SQL to Alteryx saving 6 days a month.

## Advisoira
Fee-only SEBI Registered Investment Adviser (INA000022321, registered name Partha Harshal Deshpande, valid from 20 April 2026). No commissions or product sales. Built by Partha: ETF Pulse (ETF premium and discount to NAV with a daily digest), risk profile, mutual fund overlap and diversification tools, wealth growth simulator, guides, and 30-minute discovery call booking. Full page: https://kyrie0799.github.io/#/advisoira . Not investment advice.
